title: SaaS sprawl: 36% of licenses sit unused
takeaways: Organisations leave 36% of SaaS licenses unused.
79% of IT leaders saw price increases at renewal.
Business units control 81% of SaaS spend; IT manages 15%.
Indian firms lose 27% of AI budgets to complexity.
India software spend is forecast to grow 17.6% in 2026.
source_note: Sources: Zylo 2026 SaaS Management Index; Freshworks 2026; Gartner 2025
